high_level_description: This image depicts a charming, narrow street lined with colorful, multi-story buildings. The architecture is traditional, featuring balconies adorned with wrought iron railings and windows with white frames. The buildings are painted in vibrant hues such as blue, yellow, orange, green, and pink, creating a visually striking scene. The street itself is paved with cobblestones, adding to the quaint and historic feel of the area. A few parked cars are visible along the sides of the street, including a blue van and a white van.
